def test_daily_all_six_sheets_values_filters_and_empty(self):
    from apps.daily_reports.xlsx_exports import REPORT_COLUMNS

    wb = self.workbook(self.routes()[0], rows=1)
    self.assertEqual(
        wb.sheetnames,
        [
            "گزارش‌های روزانه",
            "فعالیت‌ها",
            "نیروی انسانی",
            "تجهیزات",
            "مصالح",
            "تأخیرها",
        ],
    )

        [c.value for c in wb.active[1]], [c.label for c in REPORT_COLUMNS]
    )

    self.assertTrue(all(sheet.max_row == 1 for sheet in empty))
    self.workbook(self.routes()[0], {"reporting_date_from": "bad"}, rows=0)
    self.workbook(self.routes()[0], {"site_filter": self.site.pk}, rows=1)

def test_model_evidence_immutable_and_ui_has_four_layers_no_new_metrics(self):
    result = self.snapshot(
        code="approved_budget", project=self.project_a, review=True
    )
    result.value = {"amount": "999"}
    with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
        result.save()
    response = self.page()
    self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
    self.assertIn("no-store", response["Cache-Control"])
    for code in ("operational", "exception", "management", "executive"):
        self.assertContains(response, f'id="reporting-{code}"')
    self.assertContains(response, 'dir="rtl"')
    self.assertContains(response, "زمان مبنای منبع")
    self.assertContains(response, "نسخه شاخص")
    for invented in ("CPI", "SPI", "EVM", "liquidity_score"):
        self.assertNotContains(response, invented)
    self.capture("ready", response)
